definitions.gloss: beam, ray of light, light ray
definitions.explanation: A line or stream of light, especially one coming from a particular source.

notes:
{光線|こうせん} refers to rays or beams of light, often used in scientific or technical contexts.

TYPES:
- ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧{光線|こうせん}: sunlight, solar rays
- ⟦{紫外|しがい}→紫外：noentry⟧{光線|こうせん}: ultraviolet rays (UV)
- ⟦{赤外|せきがい}→赤外：noentry⟧{光線|こうせん}: infrared rays
- ⟦レーザー→レーザー：noentry⟧{光線|こうせん}: laser beam
- X{線|せん}: X-rays

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {光線|こうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧: to be exposed to rays
